_comment: DRAFT, not deployed. To be adapted to the deployment tool's manifest schema before use. No secret belongs in this file: SPW_RUNNER_SECRET and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY go into the node's own environment file (mode 600).

placement.note: a node that hosts NEITHER the wallet API NOR the signer; macOS (sandbox-exec is required)

processes.name: sp-wallet-research-runner
processes.env_file: ~/sp-wallet-research/.runner-env  (SPW_RUNNER_SECRET, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY — created by the owner on the node)

healthcheck.note: no listening port: the runner only makes outbound HTTPS calls. Health = GET /api/v1/research/status on the wallet (lastRunnerContact).
